title: Write the instance statement for the prime-eth lead L01 proof
prompt: Apply the lean-instance-gate skill to the Lean sources under `research/ic_prime_eth_leads_20261031/leads/L01/lean/` (its `readoff` theorems form a family of size 2). Run `tools/lean/lean-health.sh --json` for that study and quote its numbers. Write `$T_OUT/PROOF_MAP.md` with the six fields and the inheritance table, and list any upstream candidate for crypto-lean. Do not edit the study. The harness sets T_OUT (an output directory outside git); write every report file there.
setup: Fresh checkout. No fixture; the study is read-only.
acceptance: the note quotes the study's files, theorems and top_family values from lean-health.sh
check_command: for h in 'Structure above' 'Theorem used as stated' 'The object as an instance' 'Assembly probe' 'Missing components' 'Inheritance table'; do grep -qi "$h" "$T_OUT/PROOF_MAP.md" || exit 1; done && grep -q 'top_family' "$T_OUT/PROOF_MAP.md" && git diff --quiet "$T_BASE" HEAD -- research/ic_prime_eth_leads_20261031/leads/L01
forbidden: editing a file whose SHA-256 a tracked manifest pins (frozen evidence) to make a check pass
disabling, skipping, deleting or weakening a test or check to make it pass
editing the checking tool or its allow-list so that it passes
notes: lean-health.sh needs no Lean toolchain. Correctness of the table is judged by the validator.
